name: invoices-ap-vendor-ref-en
query: Book the bill from {vendor_name}: their invoice number VF-90817, 10 x {purchase_item}.
expected_behavior: Treats this as an AP invoice (PurchaseInvoices) from a vendor, not an AR invoice
Resolves the vendor's CardCode (a supplier) and the ItemCode with live queries
The receipt carries the vendor's invoice number VF-90817 as the vendor reference (NumAtCard)
The receipt has the resolved item with quantity 10
Shows a confirmation receipt and stops to ask the user to confirm before posting
